Name: Project Starlight - Moths for SDV
Author: KeDili
Description:
Hello, y'all. This isn't my first mod like most of you will expect it to be since you guys don't see me often on Nexus.

This is Project Starlight. It's a mod that's inspired from Runaway Play's Flutter: Starlight mobile game, intends to add many enough moths (Currently, 55. More in the future if I can do it!), their 'sets', with referenced art from their game (I didn't take their art from the game of course, completely made by myself and used their art as reference.) Currently adds all moths in the following sets:

- Polilla
- Hoshi
- Hawkmoth
- Marama
- Lunar
- Silva
- Chausiku
- Estrella
- Mythic
- Zodiac
- Apoyo

If you're curious about what even Flutter: Starlight is, see their Google Play page!
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.runawayplay.starlight]https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.runawayplay.starlight

[/url]This mod requires my newly released framework, Creaturebook; the lovely framework modder PeacefulEnd﻿'s Custom Companions, and the developer of SMAPI's, Pathoschild's Content Patcher. Find them on Requirements section.
